newsitem.title: USA: Calif. pension system reorganizes health divisions.
newsitem.headline: Calif. pension system reorganizes health divisions.

text.p: The California Public Employees' Retirement System (CalPERS) -- the nation's largest public pension fund -- said on Tuesday it was consolidating two of its health divisions.
CalPERS said one division had previously been responsible for administering health benefits, while another was responsible for negotiating health plan contracts.
As part of the restructuring, CalPERS said the two divisions have been combined.

"It eliminates any confusion as to who is responsible for managing health benefits. It also allows faster decision-making and better communication, improves efficiency and reduces administrative costs," said Margaret Stanley, CalPERS assistant executive officer for health benefit services.

CalPERS provides health benefits to more than one million California public employees, retirees and their family members. Its retirement division manages the largest U.S. public pension fund, with more than $115 billion in assets.
